name: Elexon BMRS Insights Solution API

provider.name: Elexon (Balancing and Settlement Code company, Great Britain)

summary: Keyless JSON API for Great Britain electricity data: generation by fuel type, demand, system prices, balancing and market datasets from the BMRS.
description: The Insights Solution API exposes Balancing Mechanism Reporting Service data: instantaneous generation by fuel (FUELINST, 5-minute), generation outturn summaries, national demand and forecasts, system sell/buy prices per settlement period, imbalance volumes, market index data and many more datasets (over 300 paths in the OpenAPI document). Most dataset endpoints accept publish-time ranges and a format parameter.

auth.notes: The developer portal states that all APIs are public and no API key is required.

rate_limit.summary: Not documented; the portal says dataset endpoints have no restrictions or limits on data return.

endpoints.summary: System sell and buy prices per settlement period

license.name: BMRS Data Licence Terms (acknowledge the source)

coverage.temporal: Recent history to forecasts, per dataset

agent_notes: Docs are in English. Times are UTC; settlement periods are half-hours (settlementPeriod 33 = 16:00 UTC in the check). Summary endpoints return nested arrays grouped by startTime; dataset endpoints return a flat data list. Use the swagger.json to find the dataset names; the old /bmrs/api/v1/swagger path 404s.
caveats: The licence is a separate BMRS Data Licence; its commercial-use terms were not clear in the portal text, so treat commercial use as unconfirmed.
Without a time range, FUELINST returns the latest slice only.
www.elexon.co.uk answered 403 to curl; the developer portal and API host work.

verification.notes: Exact example request executed without a key; the default FUELINST request returned 200 in 2.4 s.
